statement.zh: 拉洪/卡洪及相关遗址中王国工匠镇及相关语境见 Petrie《伊拉洪、卡洪与古罗布》（1891）。
statement.en: At Lahun/Kahun and related sites, the Middle Kingdom workers’ town and associated contexts are documented in Petrie Illahun, Kahun and Gurob (1891).
